requirements: Add normalizeTags(tags): keep the valid tags, lowercased and deduplicated. A tag is valid under the same rule as a name, which src/limits.js owns.

defects.consequence: validTag copies the name rule with its own literal 64 instead of reusing validName, so the two rules drift when src/limits.js changes.

decoys.consequence: normalizeTags keeps tags that differ only in case.
decoys.evidence: src/tags.js:6 duplicates differing in case survive
decoys.reason: Tags are lowercased before the Set removes duplicates.
